description: Manage the Google accounts Sheets MCP can use. list: show signed-in accounts and the default. add: sign in to a Google account (opens a browser sign-in; also use this when a sign-in has expired). remove: sign an account out and revoke access. set_default: choose the account used for new spreadsheets.

email.description: For remove/set_default: the account's email or a unique part of it

name: google_accounts
title: Google accounts
